files.notes: Post-close discipline grading, independent of P&L: citation/direction/band base plus no-trade and non-killzone penalties. Session windows share central band functions; unknown grades excluded from GPA.

Presentation-only row and tape completeness. Counts closed 1m intervals against calendar, distinguishes unknown/partial/forming/over-held and absent whole windows, bounds scans. Does not synthesize OHLCV or block trading.

Planner facts share BreakdownContinueState with validator via resolved VoidScope. Two-sided voids collapse into CHOP; stop floor and boot line read resolved multipliers. One-sided tail instruction overgeneralizes both directions (report).

Condition live/shadow resolution session > base > env > defaults; FVG and breakout-retest default shadow. Duplicate env entry first-wins contradicts LIVE override comment; config keys expected pre-canonicalized.
Session/day digest and tapered seven-day chain; learning averages count Measured explicitly. When no excursion is measured the entire learning line, including available grades, is omitted.

Shared high-cascade context/decision/account types and mutable per-engine prompt context. Config-driven crypto candidates and data sources; futures session/expiry helpers. External HTTP is URL-validated but body unbounded. Mixed candidate order uses map iteration.

Action and entry validator applies sizing, leverage clamp, bracket direction, R:R from explicit price or snapshot, confidence, min-SL, HTF/transition/dead-plan/quality gates. Missing entry/ATR fails open; only dead-plan uses nonretryable GateRefusalError. Does not execute orders.

Routes futures system prompt externally; shared user prompt renders account, resolved history, positions, candidate data, structure, quant rankings. Tables and indicator formatter are shared. Crypto text contains conflicting output order and outdated R:R labeling; position notional omits futures multiplier.
Nil-safe watcher helper stamps wall-clock snapshot then fetches only when map empty, mutating context/engine. Reused nonempty data receives new stamp without fetch; caller freshness contract matters.

Single table of legal per-condition confirm rules, fade touch-only and two-tick structure stop, split-sweep rules; generated sorted prompt table shares authority. Stop-entry feature env defaults off; numeric offsets positive-only.

Research analytics use bars intersecting holding interval, include entry bar, count bars/ambiguity and emit Computed false on no coverage. Intrabar pre-fill/post-exit extremes cannot be separated; invalid side treated short.
Unified flat/in-position feed thresholds in milliseconds; latest subscribed bar-open age fallback. Future bars produce negative ages; env millisecond multiplication is not overflow bounded.

Death/flip age uses AcceptanceBars rule aggregation with explicit clock; no closed bar/stale bars skip transition. Separate aggregation stamps true close, so AggregateBars missing CloseTime does not infect this path.

Machine FVG candidates and write validator plus advisory/card state. Three-bar contiguous gap and ATR displacement checks; candidates tolerate missing ATR but validator rejects. AggregateBars emits epoch buckets without CloseTime, unlike acceptance aggregator. No subsequent mitigation check in candidate search.
Three embedded futures golden fixtures rerendered at boot; hashes and first differing lines returned. Checks fixed fixture contracts only, not all runtime configurations or actual broker state.
Legacy excursion uses bar OPEN timestamps within trade hold; mid-bar entry excludes containing bar. Unknown side is short. No explicit computed flag.

Power gate n>=1565 before significance/effect threshold, fixed baseline .5 and Bonferroni family8. Label mapper actually has nine named classes plus other; tests/statistics do not create matched controls.

Configurable ATR stop-width gate default1.5, zero off, missing values fail open; cited plan lookup supplies anchor. Legacy prose says default1.0 although code constant1.5. Structural reject arm changes are owned outside this file.

Nineteen literal condition-restriction fragment checks against rendered planner output contract, reported BROKEN at boot on first missing fragment. Coverage is registry-defined, not automatic validator census.
Sorted ownership-tag assertion rejects mismatched trader id; absent trader/tags passes. Partial tags do not prove every account-scoped field was tagged.

Seven-field advisory context from daily/hour/5m series: EMA trend, daily ATR rank, realized log-return vol, optional VIX and gap. No internal closed-bar/time validation. Valid zero RV is rendered absent/dark.

CME-session-day bucket baseline using >=200 bars as near-complete proxy; averages up to maxDays once minDays reached. No actual session completion/calendar check, so developing days >=200 included. Gap inputs use final two daily rows.
Seven-field unavailable-field list and threshold>3 default degraded flag. Warming positive RV counts available; zero RV marked dark despite valid flat tape possibility.

Primitive risk checks, per-trader in-memory daily trip latch and CME session reset, toggle-aware daily guards and nonblocking soft audit. Generic loss strict< differs daily guard<=. Stage-A default1 clamp configurable env; no extra per-trade dollar cap introduced.

CT registry default NY-only with ASIA/LONDON definitions, JSON codec, syntax validation, active/read/killzone predicates and calendar early flat override. Validation does not reject overlaps/duplicate names or enforce end==flat; first window wins even disabled.

Research-only replay per armed bracket for touch/1x5m/2x5m/MSS; adverse-first ambiguity and friction2 ticks. Close-fill aggregation has zero CloseTime and backdates replay to first bucket minute. Persistence caller records once; not evidence of executable trades.

Entry-only stale rewrite to wait evaluates snapshot clock, prefers1m then5m then any-TF flat threshold. Missing snapshot/data fail open with warning where possible; exits remain. Live diagnostics do not drive gate.

Legacy advisory episode registry keyed trader/symbol/label/price/session day with seed hook; bounded per-level ring, active/last state. Reads may retain old-day active states; card dereferences after unlock. closeSide5m uses adjacent-time distance rather than epoch bucket.
Cached America/Chicago location and canonical formatters. Missing zone database falls back UTC but output remains labeled CT; no runtime TZ failure reproduced.
One resolved1m tape depth default2000 and session-day lookback for prompt/validator; no-provider yields empty and no void. Horizon tracks served span/gaps; no missing-bar interpolation.
